intro: People of {partner} invited to this record by link: they see only its shared details, files and messages.
introNoParty: People outside invited to this record by link.

problem.read: The invitations could not be read.
problem.forbidden: You may not see the invitations of this record.
problem.unavailable: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.

empty.title: Nobody outside is invited yet
empty.body: Share with a partner brings one of their people into this record: no portal account needed.

held.noRight: Only people with the right to invite partners can do this.
held.noRecordRight: Inviting to this record also takes the right to change it.
held.reading: Wait until the invitations are read.
held.busy: Wait a moment: the last change is being saved.
held.ALL_COMPANIES: This record is shared by every company: invite the partner on its quote or order instead.
held.NO_PARTY: This record has no customer, supplier, workshop or brand: there is nobody outside to invite.
held.ended: This invitation has ended: invite them again for a new period.

invite.title: Share with a partner
invite.intro: They get a link to this record only: its shared details, files and messages. No portal account, no prices.
invite.toContactBody: One of the partner's people we already know.
invite.noContacts: No contact with an e-mail on file yet.
invite.toEmailBody: An agent, a designer, a lab working with this partner.
invite.viewAlways: Reading is always part of an invitation.
invite.untilHint: The link ends at 23:59 of that day. At most 180 days; a new period is a new invitation.
invite.noteHint: They read it in the invitation e-mail.
invite.mailBody: We send the link to the address now.
invite.linkBody: You get the link once and send it yourself.

problem.contact: Choose a contact with an e-mail.
problem.untilSoon: The invitation must last at least an hour from now.
problem.untilLate: An invitation lasts at most 180 days.
problem.untilRefused: The server did not take this day: choose another within 180 days.
problem.suppressed: Mail to this address bounced or was refused: correct it first.
problem.already: This address is invited to this record already: change what they may do, or revoke it first.
problem.forbidden: You may not invite partners to this record.
problem.invalid: The invitation could not be made as it is.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute.
problem.unavailable: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.
problem.failed: The invitation could not be made. Try again.

change.title: What they may do
change.body: It applies from their next click: what they are writing now is checked again when they send it.

revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
revoke.body: {email} can no longer open this record: the link stops now. What they wrote and uploaded stays on the record.

problem.changed: Someone changed this invitation a moment ago: it is shown as it is now.
problem.ended: This invitation ended or was revoked meanwhile.
problem.forbidden: You may not change this invitation.
problem.failed: That did not work. Try again.

link.title: The link for {email}
link.once: Shown once only: copy it now and send it yourself.

note.mailFailed: The invitation was made but the e-mail to {email} failed: revoke it and invite again, or pass on a link.
note.queued: The invitation to {email} is on its way.
note.linkOnce: The invitation is ready: copy the link below.
note.revoked: {email} can no longer open this record.
note.copyFailed: The link could not be copied: select it and copy it by hand.
